long_biography.plain_text:
In 2020, cryptocurrency investor Su Zhu approached markets across Asia and the West through their differing preferences. He observed that Chinese traders were more receptive to Bitcoin offshoots, while Western audiences showed greater enthusiasm for Ethereum. His investment approach combined arbitrage with longer-term holdings, and he participated directly in decentralised finance projects.

On the Uncommon Core podcast with researcher Hasu, Zhu explained the mechanics of derivatives. He described how contracts without expiry spared retail traders the need to replace expiring weekly positions. He also explained why institutions still used fixed maturities to match options exposure or expected cash flows.
